turns.question: How many degrees Celsius warmer was Istanbul than Amsterdam on average in daily temperature on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it holds no temperature or weather data and no city dimension, so I cannot say how much warmer Istanbul was than Amsterdam on 1 and 2 October 2026. The closest it offers are shop metrics by customer country (customer__country), such as Revenue (EUR) (revenue_eur) and Orders (orders_total).
